name: codex-wakectl
description: Codex skill for scheduling thread attention by time or condition.

interface.shortDescription: Schedule timed and conditional thread attention
interface.longDescription: Codex Wakectl provides guidance for durable event wakes by time or condition, explicit queued input, optional resume, v2 agent-path conditions, queue runners, repeating milestones, and blocking waits for scripts and thread-id-only controllers.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-wakectl to schedule Codex thread attention after a time or condition.
